extracted.name: Cheeseburger Rice Skillet
extracted.description: This cheeseburger rice skillet recipe includes flavorful ground beef, zucchini, tomatoes, and rice, all sautéed to perfection in this one-pan wonder!
ingredient_lines: 1 (5.5 ounce) package Knorr® Rice Sides™ - Beef flavor
Salt and black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring and breaking meat up. Transfer ground beef to a bowl.
Melt butter in the same skillet; add zucchini and sauté until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Return ground beef to the skillet. Add water, tomatoes, Knorr rice, dried onion, and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low; cover and cook, about 7 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, and top with cheese. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.
